A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right corner of the card, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 18 August 2019. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ESB2P-L-lonerogue-PC-Errata-2019-disc-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Lone Rogue (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (by 8 July 2018): Same words as the E card. The card is drawn with the same art, lore and title; there is no “E”, and a small round bronze disc sits at the lower right corner of the card.

The whole E card image and the whole disc card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
